sections.text_helper: Section 50.2 "Flash size data register" in chapter 50 (Device electronic signature), RM0522 Rev 1, page 2559.
sections.section_content:
Base address: 0x08FF F80C
Address offset: 0x00
Read only = 0xXXXX where X is factory-programmed
Bits 15:0 FLASH_SIZE[15:0]: Flash memory size
This field indicates the size of the device Flash memory expressed in Kbytes.
As an example, 0x200 corresponds to 512Kbytes.
